Terms and conditions

The rules of the game, written simply. They apply to all services, together with the order summary.

1. Purpose

These terms apply to every order placed with Alex & Lia: building a website, subscription, options, extras and related services. They complement the order summary, which sets out the type of website, the options, the extras and the prices.

2. Ordering online

Ordering takes place on the website, in three steps: choosing the website, its options and extras, entering contact details, then secure payment. Before paying, the client sees a full summary, with the amount paid that day and the amounts that follow.

By clicking "Order and pay", the client accepts these terms and places a firm order. They immediately receive a confirmation email with an order reference, to quote in all correspondence.

An order can also be placed by email or by message. It is then firm when the client accepts the summary in writing and makes the first payment.

3. Prices

Prices are in euros. VAT is not applicable (article 293 B of the French General Tax Code) as long as the business qualifies for the VAT exemption. If this changes, the displayed prices are updated. Orders already placed keep their price.

The offer is the same for all clients. It comes down to two prices: building the website, paid once, and the subscription, paid as long as the website is hosted by Alex & Lia.

Building the website costs €500. This price is the same for a single-page website and for a showcase website of up to five pages. It includes the mock-up, the complete website and putting it online.

The online shop costs €200 more, so €700 for the build. This supplement includes card payment, order tracking, putting up to 20 products online and a basic set of terms of sale that the client completes.

Build options are paid once, on top of the build price:

  • English translation, €100: the website translated into English and proofread, with a button to switch language.
  • Appointment booking, €100: a calendar on the website, where visitors book a slot from those the client opens.
  • Moving over your old website, €100: the text, photos and page addresses of the client’s old website, carried over into the new one.
  • Five more pages, €100: five pages on top of the five included, for a showcase website or an online shop.

The subscription costs €10 a month, or €100 a year (article 5). Monthly extras can be added to it (article 6).

A bigger website, or a request outside this scope, is subject to a quote that the client accepts before work begins.

4. Paying for the build

The build price is paid in two stages.

  • When ordering: a deposit of 25% of the build price, including the online shop if there is one. Build options are paid in full that day.
  • When the website is delivered: the rest, in one go.
  • Or, at delivery, in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments: the rest is split into 6 or 12 monthly instalments, as the client chooses. The subscription is then paid monthly. Each instalment is rounded down to the cent: the total never exceeds the website price. Payments stop automatically after the last instalment.

When ordering, the client chooses to pay the rest in one go or in instalments.

Example for a €500 website: the client pays €125 when ordering. At delivery, they pay €375 in one go, or €62.50 a month for 6 months, or €31.25 a month for 12 months.

5. Subscription

The subscription is required: Alex & Lia does not host any website without a subscription. There is only one, the same for every website. It starts when the website is delivered.

It includes:

  • The domain name, registered in the client’s name and renewed every year (article 9).
  • Hosting for the website, with HTTPS.
  • Updates and backups for the website.
  • Website monitoring: we check that it keeps working properly.
  • Support: a reply within 72 working hours (article 11).
  • The SEO basics: the website is built so that Google can read and understand it.
  • 100 Lia Tokens per month (article 12).
  • One change by Alex per month (article 11).
  • The client area and its tools (article 13).

The subscription is charged in advance, every month or every year depending on the period chosen by the client. Yearly, it costs €100: the client pays for 10 months out of 12, so 2 months free. The client can switch from monthly to yearly, or from yearly to monthly, at renewal.

Payments are handled by Stripe, by bank card or SEPA direct debit. Alex & Lia does not see or store bank details. Each invoice is sent by email and remains available in the client area.

If a payment fails, the client is notified by email. If nothing is settled within 30 days, the website may be paused until payment.

6. Subscription extras

An extra is an additional service, paid monthly with the subscription. No extra is required.

  • Ongoing SEO, €10 a month: SEO work carried out every month, with a review of the results.
  • Lia +, €5 a month: 500 extra Lia Tokens every month.
  • Detailed figures, €5 a month: the website’s figures hour by hour, and a report every month.
  • Business email address, €3 a month: an email address on the client’s domain name.
  • Stock management, €5 a month: the shop’s stock, counted down with each sale. For online shops only.
  • Customer accounts, €5 a month: an account for each shop customer, with their orders and addresses. For online shops only.

The client adds or removes an extra whenever they like, from their client area. The new price applies from the next billing date. When the subscription is paid yearly, the extras are too, with the same 2 months free.

7. Commitment, cancellation and end of the subscription

The subscription has no commitment. The client can stop it at any time by email or by message: the button is in their client area. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid.

One exception: when the rest of the build price is paid in instalments, the client commits for the payment period, so 6 or 12 months from delivery of the website. If they stop earlier, the rest of the build price becomes due in one go. Once the website is paid for, the subscription has no commitment.

The end of the subscription ends the extras and the hosting of the website by Alex & Lia. The client receives their website as files (text, images, pages), to host it wherever they like. The domain name belongs to them: they can transfer it to the provider of their choice. Hosting by Alex & Lia stops 30 days after the end of the subscription.

8. Right of withdrawal

A client ordering remotely has 14 days to withdraw, without giving a reason. A message through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/en/contact/) is enough.

When ordering, the client expressly requests, by ticking the box provided, that the build starts straight away. If they withdraw within these 14 days, they pay for the work already done, pro rata to the build price. The domain name already registered stays at their cost, as it is registered in their name for one year.

9. Domain name

The client is the holder of their domain name. Alex & Lia is listed as technical contact, so it can manage it. The name is registered after the first payment, if it is still available at that time.

The price of a standard .fr, .com, .net or .org domain name is included in the subscription, annual renewal included. Other extensions and so-called “premium” names, sold at a higher price by the registries, are subject to a quote.

If the client already owns a domain name, they can transfer it to Alex & Lia or keep it with their provider and point it to the website. Alex & Lia sends them the settings to apply.

10. Building the website and timescales

The client provides their text, photos and information, or prepares them with Alex & Lia from their explanations. The timescales given (one-page website: 3 to 5 days, showcase website: 1 to 2 weeks, online shop: 2 to 3 weeks) are a guide. They run from receipt of these items. The client sees their website before it goes live and can ask for adjustments to what was ordered.

11. Changes and response time

The client sends their change requests from their client area or by message. A change is a specific edit to an existing page: a text, a price, opening hours, a photo, a product. A new page or a bigger website is subject to a quote.

For each request, the client chooses who handles it:

  • Lia: the change is made by Lia, the AI of Alex & Lia, and paid for in Lia Tokens (article 12). Lia shows the client the preview and only changes the website after their approval.
  • Alex: the change is made by hand, checked and set up by Alex.

Changes by Lia. Lia handles small and medium changes: a budget of words and images per request, on a single page. The change goes live as soon as the client approves the preview, usually within 5 minutes of the request. A request too large for Lia is passed to Alex. It then counts as a change by Alex.

Change by Alex. The subscription includes one change by Alex per month. An unused change by Alex does not carry over to the next month.

Boost. When the month’s change by Alex has already been used, the client can ask for a Boost: one extra change by Alex, for €5. The client approves each Boost, and the amount is added to their next invoice. They can also choose to hold their request over to the next month.

Cancellation. The client can cancel a request free of charge within 24 hours of sending it, from their client area, up to three cancellations a month: it is then not counted, its tokens are given back, and anything Lia had put online goes back to how it was. Beyond that, cancellation must be requested from Alex.

Response time. Alex & Lia replies to every request within 72 working hours. This time is the same for all clients. Replying means taking on the request and giving a date. Small changes are usually done within that time.

12. Lia Tokens

One Lia Token is worth 1 euro cent. Lia Tokens pay for what Lia does: changes to the website and the tools in the client area (posting on social media, correcting or translating a text, advice on a photo or on a page of the website, and other tools of the same kind).

What Lia costs. A change made by Lia costs 30 Lia Tokens, plus 1 token for every 10 words written in the request, plus 10 tokens per photo attached. That comes to between 30 and 65 tokens per change. Each tool is paid for at the price shown before it is used.

Subscription tokens. The subscription gives 100 Lia Tokens per month. This usually means 2 to 3 changes by Lia, or about ten uses of the tools. These tokens are reset on the 1st of each month and do not carry over from one month to the next.

Getting more tokens. The Lia + extra adds 500 Lia Tokens per month, for €5 a month. These tokens follow the same rule as the subscription tokens: they come back on the 1st of the month, with no carry-over. The client can also buy a single top-up: 100 tokens for €1, 500 tokens for €5, 1000 tokens for €10. The top-up is added to their next invoice. Top-up tokens are not wiped at the end of the month: they stay until they are used.

Tokens given back. The tokens for a request are given back to the client in four cases: the request is passed to Alex, going live fails, the client turns down the preview, or the client cancels the request within 24 hours.

Lia Tokens and changes by Alex are counted separately.

13. Client area and account

A client area is created automatically when ordering, with the client’s email address. There, they follow their order, requests, subscription, extras and invoices. They also find Lia’s tools there, paid for in Lia Tokens (article 12). They keep their login details to themselves and notify Alex & Lia if they have any doubt about their use.

An account with no login for 12 months and no active subscription is deleted automatically, together with its requests and photos. The client is notified by email 30 days before. Logging in once is enough to cancel the deletion. Invoices are kept outside the account, for the period required by law.

14. Content provided by the client

The client guarantees that they have the right to use the text, images, logos and products they provide. They remain responsible for the legal information specific to their business: mandatory notices, the terms of sale of their shop, displayed prices.

15. Versions and artificial intelligence

Every version of the website is kept and can be restored on request. Alex & Lia uses artificial intelligence tools to work faster. A change prepared by Lia only goes live after the client has agreed, having seen the preview. The texts and advice given by Lia’s tools are suggestions: the client reads them over before using them and remains responsible for what they publish. Lia does not give legal, medical or accounting advice.

16. SEO

The SEO basics are included in the subscription. The work done every month to move the website up falls under the Ongoing SEO extra (article 6). In both cases, SEO is a best-efforts obligation. Alex & Lia applies good practice and tracks the results, without guaranteeing any given position on Google.

17. Referral and loyalty

Each client has a referral link and code in their client area. When a referred friend’s website goes live, the referrer and the referred friend each receive 1 free month of subscription, credited on the next invoice. A second website ordered by the same client gets 10% off the build. These benefits cannot be exchanged for cash.

18. Liability

Alex & Lia does everything possible to keep the website available and backed up. Alex & Lia cannot be held liable for an outage at the host, a registry or the payment service, nor for content provided by the client. Any compensation cannot exceed the amounts paid for the subscription over the last 12 months, unless the law provides otherwise.

19. Mediation and disputes

In case of disagreement, the client first writes through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/en/contact/): most questions are settled in a few exchanges. If the answer does not suit them, a consumer client can refer the matter free of charge to a consumer mediator: one is being appointed, and their details will be given here. French law applies.

Last updated: 15 November 2026.
